questions.prompt: They studied hard ___ they failed. (A so, B or, C and, D therefore, E yet)
steps: Yet contrasts effort with an unexpected outcome; and is also a grammatical simple link.

questions.prompt: The citizens are ___ intelligent than neighbouring countries (printed). (A most, B more, C some, D very, E both)
steps: Than takes more; the sentence's nationality comparison is an unsupported assertion and compares people with countries.
Use this rule or evidence to write the answer below.
questions.answer: B. More completes the comparative grammar. Correct comparison would be with people in neighbouring countries.

questions.answer: C is intended as borrow, but barrow is misspelled.
